scope: One reserved-test evaluation after development-only selection is frozen

student_grid.selection: Existing minimum-validation-MSE checkpoint; exact ties retain the earliest step
student_grid.comparison: Paired label subsets, person draws and supervised updates; pretraining and joint auxiliary compute reported separately

ntp.selection: Retain the existing frozen endpoint; legacy proxy selection is not repeated on test

student_context.test_padding_rule: Use 2048 unless a complete test stream needs more slots, then use 4096; never crop
student_context.overflow: Abort and report the unsupported stream length; do not change the model or discard the person

baselines.selection: Reuse the alpha selected on validation for each fixed method/teacher/sample-count/seed
baselines.pca: 128 unwhitened PCs of centered raw dosages, fitted on all 400 training genotypes only
baselines.privileged_control: Effect-locus ridge receives causal variant identities; the supplied-beta dosage oracle receives identities and weights

teacher_normalization: Frozen full-training means and population standard deviations; no test normalization or recalibration

uncertainty.method: Paired percentile bootstrap, conditional on fixed teachers and fitted models
uncertainty.seed_figures: Show both optimization seeds, or their mean and range; do not label seed ranges as confidence intervals
uncertainty.limitations: No bootstrap uncertainty over vocabulary discovery, teacher sampling or independent NTP pretraining seeds

unsealing_gate: All 54 predeclared primary students have completed their frozen schedules
Verify selected checkpoint hashes and validation-only selection against preserved curves
Verify public input, dictionary, teacher and NTP-parent identity
Write an immutable selection certificate before loading test genotypes for scoring
Pass synthetic target ownership, residual grammar, oracle, metric and family-bootstrap canaries
reporting: Report every predeclared teacher and arm, including negative R-squared and failed controls
Count genotype reconstruction over the retained allele catalog; do not claim phased or whole-DNA reconstruction
Record actual sequence lengths, token exposure, supervised person draws, hardware, runtime and peak memory
Keep participant genotypes, token streams, scores, predictions and embeddings outside Git
No model, teacher, tokenizer or hyperparameter selection from final-test outcomes
Preserve the first evaluation attempt and diagnose code defects with synthetic fixtures before any repeat
Publication and weight release require explicit final human privacy/IP/license/provenance authorization
